name: ecash-connect
description: Connect dapps to eCash (ECX) wallets: addresses, message signing, PSBTs, transfers and BIP300 drivechain deposits. Derived from sats-connect.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --packages external && tsc -p . --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
